segments.caption: A man with a mustache is seen outdoors in different settings, speaking to the camera, while the video also shows a close-up of a muddy ATV tire and a maroon minivan parked on a driveway.

A maroon minivan is parked on a gravel driveway next to a wooden fence, with a blue minivan parked beside it. The blue van, which has an Ontario license plate reading APZY 380, is visibly jacked up on a red floor jack, indicating it is being lifted for maintenance or repair. The scene is set outdoors in daylight, with the focus on the blue van’s raised position and the jack supporting it.
A person is working outdoors on a vehicle tire, using a wrench to remove or tighten lug nuts on the wheel hub while the tire is resting on the ground.
A person is working on a large, muddy tire outdoors, using a tool to pry or remove the tire from its rim, with close-up shots showing the effort and the dirty, rugged environment.

A person is shown removing a tire from a vehicle, using tools to pry it off the wheel rim in an outdoor, dirt-covered setting. The tire is eventually fully detached and laid on the ground, revealing its inner structure.
A person uses a tool to work on the rim of a tire lying on the ground, with a bottle of liquid nearby, suggesting a repair or maintenance task is underway.
A close-up view shows a dirty, off-road tire being cleaned with a spray bottle and a tool, likely a tire iron or pry bar, as it sits on a concrete surface next to a red toolbox.

A man with a mustache speaks outdoors in a backyard, with a wooden fence and a parked truck visible behind him. In a separate shot, a rugged tire lies on a concrete surface next to a spray bottle and a wrench, suggesting a repair or maintenance task is underway.
